sentences.text: 大家好，欢迎来参加本次的讨论会啊，咱们这次讨论会呢主要是说一下短视频APP对我们的生活的一个影响以及体验的一个调查。

sentences.text: 那咱们先做那个商场的，然后还是先做那个电商的，还是先做直播的？
sentences.punctuation_status: Original punctuation retained; terminal full stop appended only if absent, with uncertain segment-based boundary.

sentences.speaker: SPK8014

sentences.text: 同时呢还是会是会不会有点乱，然后。
sentences.punctuation_status: Original punctuation retained; terminal full stop appended only if absent, with uncertain segment-based boundary.
sentences.speaker: SPK8014

sentences.text: 但是那个促销促销的力度，然后在哪一个平台的力度大，然后那个这个这个人群也会有比较的，最后会不会影响到咱们的直播效果。
sentences.punctuation_status: Original punctuation retained; terminal full stop appended only if absent, with uncertain segment-based boundary.
sentences.speaker: SPK8014

sentences.text: 现在这个直播的时候，它好像做的一般都是呃只要当天直播当天就必须是最低价格，然后还得是赠品最多的情况下。
sentences.punctuation_status: Original punctuation retained; terminal full stop appended only if absent, with uncertain segment-based boundary.
sentences.speaker: SPK8014

sentences.text: 这样的话，然后会呃也会影响当天的。
sentences.punctuation_status: Original punctuation retained; terminal full stop appended only if absent, with uncertain segment-based boundary.
sentences.speaker: SPK8014

sentences.text: 当天的其他的平台的销售，所以我觉得。
sentences.punctuation_status: Original punctuation retained; terminal full stop appended only if absent, with uncertain segment-based boundary.
sentences.speaker: SPK8014

sentences.punctuation_status: Original punctuation retained; terminal full stop appended only if absent, with uncertain segment-based boundary.
sentences.speaker: SPK8014

sentences.text: 但是但是只是你这个平台的，那个哪一个平台的那个优惠力度是最大的，然后别人也会也会看，所以咱们想用直播的。
sentences.punctuation_status: Original punctuation retained; terminal full stop appended only if absent, with uncertain segment-based boundary.
sentences.speaker: SPK8014

sentences.punctuation_status: Original punctuation retained; terminal full stop appended only if absent, with uncertain segment-based boundary.
sentences.speaker: SPK8014

sentences.text: 就那一时间段嗯，然后我觉得其实也可以，用这个的话，然后咱们就当成一种广告效效应了。
sentences.punctuation_status: Original punctuation retained; terminal full stop appended only if absent, with uncertain segment-based boundary.
sentences.speaker: SPK8014

sentences.text: 比如说这一天这一个时间点，这一个小时一个小时之内我们就是最低的。
sentences.punctuation_status: Original punctuation retained; terminal full stop appended only if absent, with uncertain segment-based boundary.
sentences.speaker: SPK8014

sentences.text: 那这个时候买的人群是最多。
sentences.punctuation_status: Original punctuation retained; terminal full stop appended only if absent, with uncertain segment-based boundary.
sentences.speaker: SPK8014

sentences.text: 买的人群特别多，其实已经就能达到一个广告的效果了。
sentences.punctuation_status: Original punctuation retained; terminal full stop appended only if absent, with uncertain segment-based boundary.

sentences.text: 我觉得我们招聘这些经理也得给他们定一个他们的工作职责，他们应该干些什么东西？

sentences.text: 对，比如说营销部经理的话，我觉得他们就需要规划企业的市场战略与竞争嘛。
sentences.punctuation_status: Original punctuation retained; terminal full stop appended only if absent, with uncertain segment-based boundary.
sentences.speaker: SPK8047

sentences.text: 然后就实现市场发展目标，他们还得组织并策划各类市场营销活动方案，因为现在肯定都跟市场接轨了嘛，就有很多活动需要他们来策划一下。
sentences.punctuation_status: Original punctuation retained; terminal full stop appended only if absent, with uncertain segment-based boundary.
sentences.speaker: SPK8047

sentences.text: 才能推广我们这家餐饮企业。
